svg.title: Blue-Green Deployment
svg.desc: Blue-Green Deployment. Run the new version beside the old one and switch all traffic in one step. Step 1, Blue is live: Blue runs v1 and serves all traffic. Green, an identical environment, sits idle. Step 2, Deploy and test Green: v2 is deployed to Green and smoke-tested through a private test endpoint. Users stay on Blue. Step 3, Switch: The router sends 100% of traffic to Green in one step. Blue drains and stays warm for rollback. Step 4, Roll back or retire: Errors stay normal, so Blue goes idle and the roles swap. A spike would flip traffic back to Blue.

g.text: Blue runs v1 and serves all traffic. Green, an identical environment, sits idle.
v2 is deployed to Green and smoke-tested through a private test endpoint. Users stay on Blue.
The router sends 100% of traffic to Green in one step. Blue drains and stays warm for rollback.
Errors stay normal, so Blue goes idle and the roles swap. A spike would flip traffic back to Blue.
errors spike → flip back to Blue
kept warm: rollback is one switch away
idle: the next release deploys here
